rationale: US Treasury yields at 19-year peak continue as highest domestic financial concern; House vote on Iran war and Hegseth impeachment are new political developments.

top_events.title: US House votes to end Iran war, 7 Republicans join in favour
top_events.label: House votes to end Iran war, Republicans join
top_events.summary: House approved war powers resolution for third time, halting Trump's military action in Iran; seven Republicans joined. Significant domestic policy action on ongoing conflict.

top_events.title: Republican forces Congress to hold impeachment vote for Pete Hegseth
top_events.label: Republican forces Hegseth impeachment vote in Congress
top_events.summary: Representative Thomas Massie forces fellow Republicans to vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth. Significant domestic political action during wartime.

top_events.title: Iran war has led to US munitions shortfalls, Pentagon inspector confirms
top_events.label: Pentagon confirms munitions shortfalls from Iran war
top_events.summary: Pentagon inspector confirms munitions shortfalls and resupply bottleneck despite Trump claims. Direct concern for US military readiness and policy.

most_significant_event.label: US bond yields hit 19-year high
most_significant_event.summary: 10-year Treasury yield reaches 5.02%, highest since 2007 financial crisis, as oil prices surge. Tightens financial conditions; affects mortgage rates, business borrowing, and household costs.
most_significant_event.title: Benchmark US government bond yield hits 19-year peak as oil prices surge
